Policy: Port-data round after the acceptance run: existing port attributes only (Cổng giao tiếp / Cổng kết nối), no new attribute, column or table. Each value keeps the existing wording and adds what the manufacturer page read on 2026-10-29 states for that port: version, video direction, DisplayPort over USB-C and the published maximum mode. A port whose page could not be read, or that states no per-port data, is left unchanged (output/catalog-port-data-2/PORT_DATA_REVIEW.md).
IndependentReview: Applied through Phase B (apply_catalog_standardization.py) at the owner's request of 29/10/2026.
